description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2910015397197 PUMP,FUEL,METERING: Line 0001 Qty 19 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0074 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
